title: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 采用 Braindate 助力高效连接
originalTitle: Skip the small talk: Make game-changing connections at TechCrunch Founder Summit with Braindate
summary: TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 将于 11 月 4 日在波士顿 SoWa Power Station 举行，通过 Braindate 功能，参会者可以有针对性地安排一对一或小组会议，围绕实际感兴趣的话题进行深入交流。参会者还可免费获得第二张门票。
